shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -E '"(version|peerDependencies)"' -A5 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | grep -i -E 'calendar|date|picker'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' ' && echo && echo ---- && (timeout 25 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version 2>&1 | tail -3) && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head -3 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E '^Chevron(Left|Right)\.js$|^Calendar\.js$' && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Popup/Popup.d.ts | head -80
timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -20

timeout 240 npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -8 && grep -A4 '"dependencies"' package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build 2>&1 | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|exports)"' -A3 | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -name 'Calendar.d.ts' | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm && cat $D/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts && echo ---- && cat $D/components/Calendar/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80 && echo ---- && cat $D/components/DatePicker/DatePicker.d.ts && echo ---- && cat $D/components/DatePicker/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60 && echo ---- && ls $D/components && echo ---- && grep -rl 'dateTime\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/esm/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/esm/ | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm && cat $D/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts | head -80 && echo ---- && cat $D/components/DatePicker/hooks/datePickerStateFactory.d.ts | head -60 && echo ---- && cat $D/components/types/inputProps.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls $D/components/types && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types)"' && echo ---- && sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md | grep -n -i -E 'settings|loadLocale|import|dateTime' | head -30

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm && grep -n -A12 'interface ValueBase' $D/components/types/inputs.d.ts && echo ---- && grep -n -E '^\s+(format|toISOString|isValid|locale)\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/dateTime.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build -name '*.d.ts' | xargs grep -l 'interface DateTime' | head -2

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>/dev/null) ; echo "browser-check-done"; git status --short; cat .gitignore
sed "s#/home/sandbox/workspace/src/App#./src/App#" /tmp/smoke.tsx > ./smoke.tsx && timeout 120 npx --no-install vite-node ./smoke.tsx 2>&1 | tail -5; rm -f ./smoke.tsx; git status --short
